_doc: Each rule is a set of evidence legs evaluated deterministically over
whole-repository facts. A finding publishes only when every leg is
evidenced or absent-proven; a control-present leg retracts the rule;
an undetermined leg downgrades the finding and names itself.
Adding a rule over existing leg kinds is a data-only change (FR-003 style).

rules.title: No GraphQL query depth/complexity limit on an unauthenticated endpoint
rules.summary: The GraphQL endpoint permits anonymous access and the schema contains a type-reference cycle, while no query depth, complexity, or cost limiting is configured anywhere — a single deeply nested anonymous query fans out resolver and database calls.
rules.recommendation: Enforce a query depth/complexity limit (e.g. max-query-depth or an instrumentation-based cost analyser) and consider disabling introspection outside development.

rules.title: Seed data provisions loginable accounts with a shared, documented password
rules.summary: A migration or seed fixture provisions user accounts whose shared password is documented alongside, and a public login entrypoint accepts them — any reader of the repository can authenticate as a seeded account.
rules.recommendation: Remove seeded credentials from migrations, or scope seed data to non-deployed environments and rotate anything ever shipped.
